prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of two people shaking hands, capturing only their hands and wrists in sharp focus. One person wears a crisp white dress shirt, while the other is dressed in a dark, tailored suit jacket with a white shirt cuff visible. The person in the suit has a bold, black geometric tattoo wrapping around their wrist, adding a striking and unique visual element. The lighting is soft and cool, casting gentle highlights and subtle shadows that emphasize the texture of the skin and fabric. The background is blurred with a shallow depth of field, creating a sense of intimacy and drawing all attention to the handshake. The overall color palette is muted and modern, dominated by whites, greys, and subtle blue tones, evoking a sleek, professional, and slightly futuristic atmosphere. The composition is tight and symmetrical, with the handshake centered in the frame, conveying a sense of agreement, trust, or the sealing of an important deal.
